mapper.select: SELECT CART_ID, MEMBER_ID, CREATED_AT FROM CART WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CART_ITEM ( CART_ITEM_ID, CART_ID, PRODUCT_ID, QUANTITY ) VALUES ( CART_ITEM_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{cartId}, #{productId}, #{quantity} )
mapper.select: SELECT CART_ITEM_ID, CART_ID, PRODUCT_ID, QUANTITY FROM CART_ITEM WHERE CART_ID = #{cartId} AND PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}

SELECT CI.CART_ITEM_ID, CI.CART_ID, CI.PRODUCT_ID, CI.QUANTITY, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRICE, P.IMAGE, P.STOCK FROM CART_ITEM CI JOIN PRODUCT P ON CI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE CI.CART_ID = #{cartId} ORDER BY CI.CART_ITEM_ID
